verdict.rationale: Pylon provides building blocks that could implement handoff logic — natural-language runbooks for 'specific scenarios' (pylon-docs-15, pylon-docs-73), configurable triggers/automations (pylon-docs-30, pylon-docs-62), rubrics to enforce process (pylon-docs-45, pylon-docs-74), and manual/explicit issue assignment to agents vs humans (pylon-docs-18, pylon-docs-40) — but there is no documentation of a dedicated escalation-condition config (topic, sentiment, customer tier, explicit request) or any evidence of reliability/obedience in practice. Missing for 10: explicit escalation-rule builder referencing sentiment/tier/topic, hands-on or independent verification that the agent reliably hands off per configured conditions.
